blind.description: A conservatory-style wall section featuring a rectangular open doorway flanked and topped by multi-pane windows. The bottom corners rest on reddish-brown brick bases with stone sills, supporting a light-tan wooden frame with frosted or tinted greenish-cream glass panes (three panels on each side vertically, three panels along the top transom). The surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with smooth edges.
blind.from_above: A simple elongated horizontal tan rectangle with slightly rounded corners.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.15 times the height of the figure (around 6.5 to 7 feet tall) and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide.
